create_subproc_vec_env: create a SubprocVecEnv to run multiple gym environments in parallel subprocesses via pipes
create_parallel_adversarial_vec_env: create a ParallelAdversarialVecEnv to run adversarial environments in parallel with adversary action support
step_async_wait: run step_async then step_wait on a SubprocVecEnv to execute actions across parallel environments
reset_to_level: reset a specific parallel environment to a given level using reset_to_level on ParallelAdversarialVecEnv
remote_attr: fetch or call an arbitrary attribute on remote environments using remote_attr with optional data and flatten
